bottleneck.description: Digital flash/spinning lidar for industrial, automotive and robotics, post Velodyne merger; ~$110-150M annualized revenue, sub-scale vs Chinese leaders Hesai and RoboSense.

dependency.key_customers: Warehouse automation, yard-logistics, smart city/infrastructure, select robotaxi pilots
dependency.key_suppliers: VCSEL/laser diode vendors, SPAD/sensor IC vendors, contract manufacturers

editorial.notes: Post-Velodyne merger, Ouster competes in industrial, smart-infrastructure, automotive and robotics lidar against Hesai, RoboSense, Innoviz, Luminar, Aeva, Valeo and Continental. With Chinese suppliers holding ~95% of automotive lidar, Ouster's automotive position is marginal and its industrial/warehouse niche is contested. Q3 2025 revenue of $39.5M and improving gross margin (45%) signal product viability but no structural bottleneck. Conservative LOW; competitive market with realistic substitution.
